name: techtrip-education
description: A study partner for certifications, training and any topic you want to learn. It plans first: a mission, authoritative sources and a phased study plan. Then it teaches, works through steps with you, quizzes in easy, hard or expert mode, and builds a Markdown packet of lessons you can export at any time. Each subject keeps its own long-lived state as plain files, so you pick up where you left off from any session or AI tool. Includes a guided tour, study-orientation.
